bullets.text: In Chennai, a young man tragically died after losing his balance and falling into rainwater pooled on a bike, prompting the office to monitor flood hazards.
Severe cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged properties across Chennai, requiring the office to coordinate swift tree clearance and relief efforts.
In Thiruvallur, 61 Tasmac employees were suspended following protests against the empty bottle collection system, and the office should watch labor stability.
In Chennai Taramani, plastic garbage and waste accumulated in the Peeliamman temple pond caused a severe foul smell, and the office should clear the pollution.
Agriculture authorities in Tiruttani instructed farmers on methods to remove rainwater stagnating in fields to protect crops, and the office should support affected farmers.
Near Avadi, an elderly couple staged a dharna at the sub-registrar office alleging a 25 crore land grab involving officials, and the office must investigate.
In Thiruvallur, intoxicated men created a nuisance inside a government school, and the office should ensure enhanced security and strict action.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AMD GPU cluster in Chennai to expand India's AI infrastructure, and the office should track further tech investments.
Chennai's data centre capacity is projected to surge seven-fold to 2.3 GW by 2032, and the office should facilitate this industrial growth.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that over 50 percent of Tamil Nadu's 16,000 registered startups are women-led, and the office should promote women entrepreneurs.
The DMK IT Wing issued severe criticisms, and the office should monitor digital political narratives and responses accordingly.
